request.style: English, Celtic folk, clear female vocal joined by male harmony, Celtic harp, tin whistle, fiddle, bodhran, bouzouki, bright morning feel, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Before the larks were singing, before the kettle's call
The light came over the mountain and spilled across the wall
No word was ever spoken, no voice was ever heard
But all the sky was preaching and every cloud a word

[Chorus]
The heavens declare the glory of God
The skies proclaim the work of his hands
Day after day they pour forth speech
Night after night they reveal knowledge

[Verse]
The sun comes like a bridegroom, rejoicing in his strength
He runs from end to end of heaven the whole of the day's length
And nothing hides from his warming, no valley and no stone
And so the word of the LORD goes out to make his goodness known

[Chorus]
The heavens declare the glory of God
The skies proclaim the work of his hands
Day after day they pour forth speech
Night after night they reveal knowledge

[Bridge]
The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul
More desirable than gold, than much pure gold
Sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb

[Outro]
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
Be pleasing in your sight, O LORD, my rock and my redeemer
